newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas holds in West, firms in East.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas holds in West, firms in East.

text.p: Canadian spot natgas prices were little changed in the West but higher in the East Wednesday as some traders returned from the Toronto Gas Fair, industry sources said.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub in Alberta traded at C$1.85-1.87 per gigajoule (GJ), losing about one cent from Tuesday and down about five cents from week-ago levels.

"Some people are back in the office today, but most will be back in tomorrow. It's still very quiet," one Calgary-based trader said, referring to the absence of traders due to the Toronto Gas Fair conference.
